purpose: Prospectively compare the replay-selected ORP/Controller batching policy against the locked fixed_exploration_v0 baseline on held-out real GitHub file-discovery worlds.

policy_source.live_translation: Only batch_fraction is translated into the live file-probe interface. Candidate ranking is identical for both policies and is outcome-independent SHA256(task_id|path) order.

live_interface.action: HTTP GET one pinned raw GitHub file
live_interface.observation: whether exact target string occurs in fetched UTF-8 text
live_interface.stop: after the first completed batch containing at least one target match, or after all candidates
live_interface.cost: number of HTTP GET probes issued
live_interface.latency: wall-clock seconds for live policy rollout
live_interface.verification_overhead: After both policy rollouts, all candidate files are fetched once for task-validity audit. This overhead is recorded separately and excluded from policy cost.

objective.information_gain: If exactly one target file exists among n candidates, successful identification yields log2(n) bits.
objective.primary: mean utility difference dream - baseline across valid held-out tasks
objective.noninferiority: dream resolution rate must be >= baseline resolution rate

decision_rule.evaluation_closure: C7 evaluation is closed if all >=8 preregistered tasks are valid, both policies run from zero observations, evaluator is unchanged, and predicted/actual IG, probes, rounds, latency and utility are logged.
decision_rule.controller_improved: mean utility difference > 0 AND dream total probes <= baseline total probes AND dream resolution rate >= baseline
decision_rule.controller_not_improved: otherwise; this does not invalidate the prospective evaluation itself

ordering: For every task, candidates are sorted by SHA256(task_id + '|' + path), ascending. The target outcome is never used for ordering.
claim_ceiling: This is an engineering controller evaluation on public code-discovery tasks. It does not establish VEA transfer, LoopCell capability accumulation, or general ORP superiority.
